implementation: Native per-waiter pthread condition, one registry mutex serializes registration/unlock/wait and wake selection. Apple relative timeout; no retry extending the timeout. Spurious wakes allowed. Guest lock reacquired before every normal/timeout return. CS depth must equal one and a native lifetime reference survives sleep. Idle object returns to zero and retires registry metadata.
limits: No cancellation, asynchronous thread termination, guest SEH, cross-process use, fairness, internal Windows encoding, copied live objects, or unspecified SRW flag values beyond 0/1. Misuse and host failures stop explicitly. This service test does not establish an original guest thread or game-loop integration.
